title: Postgres RecordKeeper Config
description:
Config node for a Postgres-backed RecordKeeper.

Contains connection details and transaction settings.

one_transaction.title: One Transaction
one_transaction.description: Whether to execute all operations within a single transaction.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Connection details for the Postgres database.

host.title: Host
host.description: The hostname of the Postgres server.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port number of the Postgres server.

dbname.title: Database Name
dbname.description: The name of the Postgres database.

user.title: User
user.description: The username for authenticating with the Postgres database.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for authenticating with the Postgres database.

sslmode.title: SSL Mode
sslmode.description: The SSL mode to use for the connection. One of 'disable', 'allow', 'prefer', 'require', 'verify-ca', or 'verify-full'.

sslcert.title: SSL Certificate
sslcert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (if required).

connect_timeout.title: Connect Timeout
connect_timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for a connection to be established. 0 or less means no timeout.

group_id.title: Group ID
group_id.description: Optional group identifier for the RecordKeeper. If provided, it can be used to logically group records in multitenant environments, e.g. 'UsersDb', 'Dev'.

auto_deploy.title: Auto Deploy
auto_deploy.description: Whether to automatically deploy/upgrade the RecordKeeper schema if it does not exist. If false, the schema must be created manually before use.

source_code_location_override.title: Source Code Location Override
source_code_location_override.description: Optional path to the database source code directory. If provided, it is used to grab the SQL scripts for deploying/upgrading the RecordKeeper schema. If not provided, the default location is used.
